risk_if_not_implemented: Without Continuous Monitoring Plan, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Control Validation Testing (CVT)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to formally assess the security, compliance and resilience controls in Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) through Information Assurance Program (IAP) activities to determine the extent to which the controls are implemented correctly, operating as intended and producing the desired outcome with respect to meeting expected requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Control Validation Testing (CVT) (IAO-04) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Continuous Monitoring Plan (TDA-06.2) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Testing Throughout Development
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to require system developers/integrators consult with security, compliance and/or resilience personnel to: 
(1) Create and implement a Security Testing and Evaluation (ST&E) plan, or similar capability;
(2) Implement a verifiable flaw remediation process to correct weaknesses and deficiencies identified during the control testing and evaluation process; and
(3) Document the results.
compensating_control_2.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Testing Throughout Development (TDA-17) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Continuous Monitoring Plan (TDA-06.2) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
